name: Trigger: OnFirstWindowOpen
purpose: File-open trigger of karbon_data: on the first window, goes to the "meta" layout and creates a meta record if the table has none, goes to the "Globals" layout and creates a record if the table has none, then returns to the original layout.
writes:
new record: meta (New Record/Request step 14, only if meta has no records)
new record: Globals (New Record/Request step 20, only if Globals has no records)
open_question: These seed the singleton records that global/utility fields and settings need; the target must create the equivalent configuration rows. Also run by karbon_kontacts System Startup (step 8) and by "Use Local Data File" (script 5). Set as the OnFirstWindowOpen file option.

name: Trigger: OnLastWindowClose
purpose: File-close trigger of karbon_data: when the multi-user state is not "multi-user on hosted" (2), clears meta::CurrentUserId and User::SmtpPassword, sets multi-user on (hidden), goes to the meta layout, locks and hides toolbars, shows the menu bar and resets the window size and position to 1028x768 at 0,0.
writes:
meta::CurrentUserId#3 (Set Field step 5, global)
User::SmtpPassword#118 (Set Field step 6, global)
open_question: Clearing meta::CurrentUserId and the SMTP password on close is a session-cleanup that the target must reproduce with session expiry. Set as the OnLastWindowClose file option.

name: Use Local Data File

open_question: Not called by any script, button, trigger or menu in the DDR set. $$UseOpenDatFile is never read in the karbon_data file scripts seen here (search whether another file reads it).

name: Commander
purpose: Developer remote-control script: evaluates the script parameter (Let notation) or variables set from the calling URL into $command and runs a developer action: open Manage Database, Script Workspace or Manage Layouts, bring to front or hide the window, reset an account password, delete an account, deactivate an account, or return the file version (meta::FileVersion as JSON). Effect owner if kept: server-domain (account administration), not needed in the target.
writes:
accounts: Reset Account Password (step 20, account $AccountName, no forced change at next login)
accounts: Delete Account (step 22, account $AccountName)
accounts: Enable Account [Deactivate] (step 24, account $AccountName; the command is named DisableAccount)
callers: none found (may be called by name)
external:
Open Manage Database (step 10)
Open Script Workspace (step 12)
Open Manage Layouts (step 14)
Evaluate of the script parameter (step 6): by name command, arbitrary expression
open_question: Security: step 6 runs Evaluate(Get(ScriptParameter)) so any caller who can run the script can execute an arbitrary calculation, and $AccountName / $NewPassword are taken from the caller's variables (via the developer URL). Needs to be removed or locked down in the target. secret: step 20 sets an account password from $NewPassword. Not called by any script, button, trigger or menu (called by URL from the developer utility file, per the comment at step 1).

name: Re-login { data }
purpose: Re-authenticates the current file session with the account name and password passed in a JSON parameter (Re-Login, no dialog), so the file opened by Karbon uses the same account.
callers: none found (may be called by name)
